description: Department: Marketing & Communications Location: Berlin Description The Growth Marketing Manager owns growth for osapiens' CMMS software – a product line for automating a company's maintenance operations, built and run with the speed and instincts of a founder driving a new product to market. The job spans building out CMMS's market presence (website, digital ads, value proposition) and pushing revenue hard from day one, across a GTM motion that blends self-serve/PLG with Sales-led demand capture, the majority of which flows to Sales – both need attention, neither at the other's expense. This is a genuine growth role: relentlessly data-driven, but with the creative instinct to spot and chase opportunities a pure numbers read would miss. Agencies support execution on performance channels and the website, and this person directs that work – but the real job is finding what actually moves revenue and going after it fast, in an environment where the playbook is still being written. What You’ll Own Growth strategy Own the growth strategy across both self-serve/PLG and Sales-led demand capture Set the channel mix to hit the CMMS-specific growth targets, revisited as the product and market evolve Bring hunger to the role: chase revenue like it's a founder's own product, using AI to move at a high pace Market presence & positioning Build and own CMMS's market presence – website, digital ads, LinkedIn page, positioning, and everything else this product line needs to show up strongly, not just a set of digital assets Define CMMS-specific positioning and messaging for its buyers (maintenance managers, operations leads, facility directors), in partnership with Product and Sales Digital Campaign Management & Demand Capture Own digital campaign execution across paid, SEO/GEO, and CMMS's other core channels – hands-on where it matters, working through agencies where it multiplies reach; using AI to handle the volume work a full team would otherwise do Build the path from first interest to a qualified Sales handoff, and design the equivalent journey for self-serve users – trial, activation, and expansion Direct the digital performance agency and website agency, briefing and holding them accountable to CMMS's goals – execution partners, not a substitute for this person's own hands-on involvement Stakeholder alignment & reporting Get every stakeholder – Product, Sales, agencies, Marketing Operations – genuinely bought in and contributing to CMMS's growth, not just informed of it Build and own CMMS's reporting from the ground up, AI-assisted – pipeline, revenue, trial sign-ups and activation, cost per MQL/SQL, channel ROI – not inheriting someone else's dashboard Report CMMS growth and revenue performance with commercially-framed recommendations This role covers a full product's marketing ownership, and that only works with the help of AI doing what a small team normally would What You’ll Bring Background 5-8+ years in digital, performance, or growth marketing, ideally with a track record in a fast-growing SaaS business Hands-on experience building or scaling a PLG motion – free trials, freemium, in-product activation – not just familiarity with the concept Experience building demand capture for a Sales-led motion Deep, practical channel expertise across paid, SEO/GEO, and digital campaigns Experience directing agencies or external partners, not only executing personally Genuine AI fluency in a marketing execution context – using AI daily to cover ground a small team would otherwise need Experience in CMMS, industrial SaaS, maintenance management, or adjacent verticals (facilities, operations, asset management) is a strong plus Fluent English required; German is a plus How you work Owns outcomes like a founder would – genuinely hungry to grow CMMS's revenue, not just execute a marketing plan Equally comfortable being hands-on and directing others – runs campaigns personally and holds agencies accountable, as the moment requires Combines rigor with instinct: reads the data, but also spots and chases opportunities the data alone wouldn't surface Thrives without a fixed playbook – builds the approach as CMMS's market presence takes shape, rather than needing one handed to them Proactively brings Product, Sales, and agency partners along, rather than working in a silo and reporting out after the fact What Success Looks Like First 3 months CMMS's website, ads, and LinkedIn presence are live, positioning is defined, and the SEA/SEO/PLG funnel has been audited with a clear action plan The core structure for both funnels – self-serve and Sales-led – is set up and running First paid campaigns are live with baseline KPIs established, and signal-based workflows are feeding Sales outreach directly Reporting infrastructure exists from day one, even if still maturing By year one CMMS has a strong, established market presence within osapiens' portfolio – its digital presence no longer reads as an afterthought Both self-serve and Sales-led pipeline are measurably growing CMMS's search presence (SEA, SEO, GEO) is strong and compounding across target markets, and funnel conversion is consistently improving Leadership can see exactly what's driving CMMS's revenue, and the Growth Marketer can clearly account for it Join us for this and more... A purpose-driven mission where you tackle complex sustainability challenges alongside global industry pioneers. Room for creativity through collaborative teamwork and an open communication culture. Flexibility and team bonding with our hybrid work options. Fuel for your growth journey, both personally and professionally. Sustainable mobility options, promoting eco-friendly commuting solutions. Fun team events and outings with our global teams.

description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat een goed idee van een klant uiteindelijk ook echt een goed werkende IT-oplossing wordt? Als Business Analyst ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen de business, de klant en development. Je duikt in processen, stelt de juiste vragen, brengt requirements boven tafel en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke user stories waar ontwikkelteams mee aan de slag kunnen. Bedrijfsomschrijving Omschrijving Je werkt aan uiteenlopende maatwerkoplossingen voor onze opdrachtgevers met vaak complexe en unieke vraagstukken. Van grote industriële organisaties tot publieke en internationale instellingen. Geen standaardoplossingen dus, maar projecten waar je echt meerwaarde kan leveren. Wat ga je doen? Als Business Analyst ben je vanaf de start van een traject nauw betrokken bij de klant. Je onderzoekt hoe processen momenteel verlopen, waar knelpunten zitten en wat er nodig is om deze met een IT-oplossing te ondersteunen. Je bent niet alleen betrokken bij het begin van een project. Ook tijdens de ontwikkeling blijf je de verbinding tussen klant en team bewaken. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: In kaart brengen en analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen bij klanten. Ophalen, analyseren en structureren van requirements. Doorvragen naar de achterliggende behoefte en onderscheid maken tussen hoofd- en bijzaken. Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete user stories en requirements. Opbouwen en onderhouden van een backlog, bijvoorbeeld in Azure DevOps. Samenwerken met Product Owners en hen waar nodig ondersteunen. De vertaalslag maken van businessvraagstukken naar ontwikkelteams. Developers voorzien van voldoende context en informatie om de juiste oplossing te bouwen. Tijdens de ontwikkelfase betrokken blijven bij vragen, wijzigingen en verdere uitwerking. Vastleggen van relevante documentatie en projectinformatie. Meedenken in pre-sales en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen bij bestaande klanten. Je nieuwe team Als Business Analist maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair team van Developers, Solution Architects en Microsoft-specialisten. Samen realiseer je slimme maatwerkoplossingen die direct bijdragen aan de doelstellingen van onze opdrachtgevers. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van inhoudelijke diepgang, afwisseling en ontwikkeling. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten, krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en hebt directe invloed op de oplossingen die worden ontworpen en gerealiseerd. Tegelijkertijd kun je rekenen op een team waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en vakmanschap centraal staan. Kortom: een omgeving waarin je wordt uitgedaagd en zichtbare impact maakt! description: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About The Team The Deployment Technology team is transforming how Workday is deployed and managed. Our mission is to reduce deployment time, cost and complexity while accelerating customer time to value. We build capabilities that enable implementers, consultants and our partner ecosystem to accelerate customer deployments using best-in-class generative AI experiences, intelligent automation, reusable configuration, Skills, MCP and platform services. We also bring these capabilities into Workday so customers can manage and maintain their environments more independently, adopt new features and SKUs, and manage ongoing change through intuitive, AI-enabled experiences. Working closely with customers, partners and product teams across Workday, we are defining the next generation of deployment technology and helping make implementation and ongoing change simpler, faster and more scalable. About The Role As a Product Manager in Deployment Technology, you will help shape and deliver capabilities that make Workday deployments faster, simpler and more scalable. You will contribute to product strategy and roadmap development while owning defined initiatives and capabilities from discovery through delivery and iteration. Contribute to product strategy and roadmap development, helping identify and prioritize important customer and deployment problems. Own defined initiatives and capabilities from discovery through delivery, launch and iteration. Work directly with customers, partners and implementation teams to understand problems, validate needs and shape solutions. Translate complex problems into clear product priorities, requirements and user experiences. Partner closely with engineering and design, making informed trade-offs across customer value, technical feasibility and broader product direction. Use customer insight, product data and feedback to measure outcomes and continuously improve the capabilities you own. Explore and apply modern AI tooling, contributing to AI-enabled experiences including Skills, MCP-based tools, automation and agentic workflows. Collaborate across Workday teams and communicate priorities, decisions and progress clearly. About You Basic Qualifications 4+ years of Product Management experience delivering software products, enterprise SaaS or platform capabilities. Experience contributing to product strategy and roadmaps and owning initiatives through discovery, delivery and iteration. Experience working closely with software engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle. Proven ability to translate customer problems into clear product priorities and requirements. Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across technical and business stakeholders. Other Qualifications Strong customer empathy, curiosity and problem-solving skills. Comfort operating in technically complex and ambiguous product areas. Active interest in AI and how AI tools can improve products, customer experiences and product management itself. Familiarity with AI-enabled products, agents, MCP, APIs, automation or workflow technologies is beneficial. Experience with enterprise SaaS, implementation, deployment technology, configuration management or ERP ecosystems is advantageous. Ability to identify scalable, reusable solutions rather than solving only for individual feature requests.
